desc: describeError / describe_error / DescribeError vectors (clients/js friendly.ts is the reference). cases: input is a string (a code or 'code: text'), null, or an object { code?, data?, message?, name? } standing for an error; expect is { code, message, hint? } (hint absent = none). A client accepts what its language can build (C# Exception or code string, GDScript Dictionary) but must give this exact result. iceFailedMessages: the ice_failed message text each client puts on its own error (clients lists who has it; absent = all three); relayConfigured = a TURN entry is configured, byIp = joined by IP address, portRange = [begin, end] for the host's port_range_full message.
